items.title: Aptiv (APTV) Faces A Fair Value Test On Mixed Third Quarter Results
items.summary: Aptiv (NYSE:APTV) is back in focus after third quarter results that combined solid earnings and new business wins with a more cautious cash flow outlook and fresh warnings about 2027 risks. The third quarter update lands after a rough stretch for Aptiv shareholders, with the share price down 47.3% year to date and the 1-year total shareholder return declining 39.6%. The latest 6.5% single-day drop and 12.1% 90-day share price decline suggest investors are still recalibrating growth hopes...

items.title: AI data center stocks drop as Democrats sweep U.S. midterms
items.summary: Investing.com - Democrats swept the U.S. midterm elections, sparking a selloff in artificial intelligence data center stocks. Investors are bracing for tighter regulatory oversight, potential rollbacks of tech tax incentives, and heightened antitrust scrutiny, which could slow down the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure.
